% An anisotropic PGF ellipse used as an uncertainty marker.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,plotmarks}

\pgfdeclareplotmark{uncertainty ellipse}{
  \pgfpathellipse{\pgfpointorigin}
    {\pgfqpoint{1.5\pgfplotmarksize}{0pt}}
    {\pgfqpoint{0pt}{.65\pgfplotmarksize}}
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[-Stealth] (-.4,0) -- (4.5,0) node[right] {$t$};
  \draw[-Stealth] (0,-.4) -- (0,3.5) node[above] {$s$};
  \draw[gray,densely dashed] (0,0) -- (1,1.1) -- (2,1.8) -- (3,2.2) -- (4,2.8);
  \draw[red!75!black,mark size=5pt,line width=.7pt]
    plot[only marks,mark=uncertainty ellipse]
      coordinates {(1,1.1) (2,1.8) (3,2.2) (4,2.8)};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
